quran_text_all_rows.arabic_uthmani: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَهُ ٱلْحَمْدُ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَنزِلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ٱلْغَفُورُ

وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَا تَأْتِينَا ٱلسَّاعَةُ ۖ قُلْ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّى لَتَأْتِيَنَّكُمْ عَٰلِمِ ٱلْغَيْبِ ۖ لَا يَعْزُبُ عَنْهُ مِثْقَالُ ذَرَّةٍۢ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَلَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَآ أَصْغَرُ مِن ذَٰلِكَ وَلَآ أَكْبَرُ إِلَّا فِى كِتَٰبٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
لِّيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَرِزْقٌۭ كَرِيمٌۭ
وَٱلَّذِينَ سَعَوْ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا مُعَٰجِزِينَ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ مِّن رِّجْزٍ أَلِيمٌۭ
وَيَرَى ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ هُوَ ٱلْحَقَّ وَيَهْدِىٓ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هَلْ نَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍۢ يُنَبِّئُكُمْ إِذَا مُزِّقْتُمْ كُلَّ مُمَزَّقٍ إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى خَلْقٍۢ جَدِيدٍ
أَفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَم بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌۢ ۗ بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ وَٱلضَّلَٰلِ ٱلْبَعِيدِ

أَفَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ إِن نَّشَأْ نَخْسِفْ بِهِمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ أَوْ نُسْقِطْ عَلَيْهِمْ كِسَفًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ لِّكُلِّ عَبْدٍۢ مُّنِيبٍۢ
۞ وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا دَاوُۥدَ مِنَّا فَضْلًۭا ۖ يَٰجِبَالُ أَوِّبِى مَعَهُۥ وَٱلطَّيْرَ ۖ وَأَلَنَّا لَهُ ٱلْحَدِيدَ
أَنِ ٱعْمَلْ سَٰبِغَٰتٍۢ وَقَدِّرْ فِى ٱلسَّرْدِ ۖ وَٱعْمَلُوا۟ صَٰلِحًا ۖ إِنِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌۭ

وَلِسُلَيْمَٰنَ ٱلرِّيحَ غُدُوُّهَا شَهْرٌۭ وَرَوَاحُهَا شَهْرٌۭ ۖ وَأَسَلْنَا لَهُۥ عَيْنَ ٱلْقِطْرِ ۖ وَمِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ مَن يَعْمَلُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِۦ ۖ وَمَن يَزِغْ مِنْهُمْ عَنْ أَمْرِنَا نُذِقْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
يَعْمَلُونَ لَهُۥ مَا يَشَآءُ مِن مَّحَٰرِيبَ وَتَمَٰثِيلَ وَجِفَانٍۢ كَٱلْجَوَابِ وَقُدُورٍۢ رَّاسِيَٰتٍ ۚ ٱعْمَلُوٓا۟ ءَالَ دَاوُۥدَ شُكْرًۭا ۚ وَقَلِيلٌۭ مِّنْ عِبَادِىَ ٱلشَّكُورُ

فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَوْتِهِۦٓ إِلَّا دَآبَّةُ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَأْكُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُۥ ۖ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ ٱلْجِنُّ أَن لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
لَقَدْ كَانَ لِسَبَإٍۢ فِى مَسْكَنِهِمْ ءَايَةٌۭ ۖ جَنَّتَانِ عَن يَمِينٍۢ وَشِمَالٍۢ ۖ كُلُوا۟ مِن رِّزْقِ رَبِّكُمْ وَٱشْكُرُوا۟ لَهُۥ ۚ بَلْدَةٌۭ طَيِّبَةٌۭ وَرَبٌّ غَفُورٌۭ
فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
ذَٰلِكَ جَزَيْنَٰهُم بِمَا كَفَرُوا۟ ۖ وَهَلْ نُجَٰزِىٓ إِلَّا ٱلْكَفُورَ
وَجَعَلْنَا بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ ٱلْقُرَى ٱلَّتِى بَٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا قُرًۭى ظَٰهِرَةًۭ وَقَدَّرْنَا فِيهَا ٱلسَّيْرَ ۖ سِيرُوا۟ فِيهَا لَيَالِىَ وَأَيَّامًا ءَامِنِينَ
فَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا بَٰعِدْ بَيْنَ أَسْفَارِنَا وَظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ أَحَادِيثَ وَمَزَّقْنَٰهُمْ كُلَّ مُمَزَّقٍ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍۢ شَكُورٍۢ
وَلَقَدْ صَدَّقَ عَلَيْهِمْ إِبْلِيسُ ظَنَّهُۥ فَٱتَّبَعُوهُ إِلَّا فَرِيقًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
وَمَا كَانَ لَهُۥ عَلَيْهِم مِّن سُلْطَٰنٍ إِلَّا لِنَعْلَمَ مَن يُؤْمِنُ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ مِمَّنْ هُوَ مِنْهَا فِى شَكٍّۢ ۗ وَرَبُّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ حَفِيظٌۭ
قُلِ ٱدْعُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ زَعَمْتُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍۢ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَلَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا لَهُمْ فِيهِمَا مِن شِرْكٍۢ وَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْهُم مِّن ظَهِيرٍۢ
وَلَا تَنفَعُ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا لِمَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُۥ ۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فُزِّعَ عَن قُلُوبِهِمْ قَالُوا۟ مَاذَا قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ ٱلْحَقَّ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
۞ قُلْ مَن يَرْزُقُكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ ۖ وَإِنَّآ أَوْ إِيَّاكُمْ لَعَلَىٰ هُدًى أَوْ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
قُل لَّا تُسْـَٔلُونَ عَمَّآ أَجْرَمْنَا وَلَا نُسْـَٔلُ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
قُلْ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَنَا رَبُّنَا ثُمَّ يَفْتَحُ بَيْنَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَهُوَ ٱلْفَتَّاحُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
قُلْ أَرُونِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَلْحَقْتُم بِهِۦ شُرَكَآءَ ۖ كَلَّا ۚ بَلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ إِلَّا كَآفَّةًۭ لِّلنَّاسِ بَشِيرًۭا وَنَذِيرًۭا وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
قُل لَّكُم مِّيعَادُ يَوْمٍۢ لَّا تَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ عَنْهُ سَاعَةًۭ وَلَا تَسْتَقْدِمُونَ

وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَن نُّؤْمِنَ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ وَلَا بِٱلَّذِى بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ ۗ وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذِ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ مَوْقُوفُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ يَرْجِعُ بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَىٰ بَعْضٍ ٱلْقَوْلَ يَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتُضْعِفُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ لَوْلَآ أَنتُمْ لَكُنَّا مُؤْمِنِينَ
قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتُضْعِفُوٓا۟ أَنَحْنُ صَدَدْنَٰكُمْ عَنِ ٱلْهُدَىٰ بَعْدَ إِذْ جَآءَكُم ۖ بَلْ كُنتُم مُّجْرِمِينَ

وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتُضْعِفُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ بَلْ مَكْرُ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذْ تَأْمُرُونَنَآ أَن نَّكْفُرَ بِٱللَّهِ وَنَجْعَلَ لَهُۥٓ أَندَادًۭا ۚ وَأَسَرُّوا۟ ٱلنَّدَامَةَ لَمَّا رَأَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلْأَغْلَٰلَ فِىٓ أَعْنَاقِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۚ هَلْ يُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا فِى قَرْيَةٍۢ مِّن نَّذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتْرَفُوهَآ إِنَّا بِمَآ أُرْسِلْتُم بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ
وَقَالُوا۟ نَحْنُ أَكْثَرُ أَمْوَٰلًۭا وَأَوْلَٰدًۭا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
قُلْ إِنَّ رَبِّى يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

وَمَآ أَمْوَٰلُكُمْ وَلَآ أَوْلَٰدُكُم بِٱلَّتِى تُقَرِّبُكُمْ عِندَنَا زُلْفَىٰٓ إِلَّا مَنْ ءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ جَزَآءُ ٱلضِّعْفِ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَهُمْ فِى ٱلْغُرُفَٰتِ ءَامِنُونَ
وَٱلَّذِينَ يَسْعَوْنَ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا مُعَٰجِزِينَ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُحْضَرُونَ
قُلْ إِنَّ رَبِّى يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَقْدِرُ لَهُۥ ۚ وَمَآ أَنفَقْتُم مِّن شَىْءٍۢ فَهُوَ يُخْلِفُهُۥ ۖ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ جَمِيعًۭا ثُمَّ يَقُولُ لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ أَهَٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِيَّاكُمْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ
قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَٰنَكَ أَنتَ وَلِيُّنَا مِن دُونِهِم ۖ بَلْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ ٱلْجِنَّ ۖ أَكْثَرُهُم بِهِم مُّؤْمِنُونَ
فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا يَمْلِكُ بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍۢ نَّفْعًۭا وَلَا ضَرًّۭا وَنَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ

وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ قَالُوا۟ مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّا رَجُلٌۭ يُرِيدُ أَن يَصُدَّكُمْ عَمَّا كَانَ يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُكُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ إِفْكٌۭ مُّفْتَرًۭى ۚ وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
وَمَآ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُم مِّن كُتُبٍۢ يَدْرُسُونَهَا ۖ وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمْ قَبْلَكَ مِن نَّذِيرٍۢ
وَكَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ وَمَا بَلَغُوا۟ مِعْشَارَ مَآ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ رُسُلِى ۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ

۞ قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَعِظُكُم بِوَٰحِدَةٍ ۖ أَن تَقُومُوا۟ لِلَّهِ مَثْنَىٰ وَفُرَٰدَىٰ ثُمَّ تَتَفَكَّرُوا۟ ۚ مَا بِصَاحِبِكُم مِّن جِنَّةٍ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌۭ لَّكُم بَيْنَ يَدَىْ عَذَابٍۢ شَدِيدٍۢ
قُلْ مَا سَأَلْتُكُم مِّنْ أَجْرٍۢ فَهُوَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ شَهِيدٌۭ
قُلْ إِنَّ رَبِّى يَقْذِفُ بِٱلْحَقِّ عَلَّٰمُ ٱلْغُيُوبِ
قُلْ جَآءَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَمَا يُبْدِئُ ٱلْبَٰطِلُ وَمَا يُعِيدُ

وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذْ فَزِعُوا۟ فَلَا فَوْتَ وَأُخِذُوا۟ مِن مَّكَانٍۢ قَرِيبٍۢ
وَقَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلتَّنَاوُشُ مِن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍۢ
وَقَدْ كَفَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَيَقْذِفُونَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ مِن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍۢ
وَحِيلَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ مَا يَشْتَهُونَ كَمَا فُعِلَ بِأَشْيَاعِهِم مِّن قَبْلُ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ فِى شَكٍّۢ مُّرِيبٍۭ

parent_channels.name: P1: Hidden Transit Remains Legible

subchannels.name: Boundary Transit Without Loss
subchannels.scene_or_process: Things enter, emerge, descend, and ascend through opposed interfaces while remaining continuously knowable.
subchannels.active_motifs: interior ingress (`quranic:root_001682:B001/m01`), emergence to the exterior (`quranic:root_000400:B001/m01`), downward arrival (`quranic:root_001492:B001/m01`), upward ascent (`quranic:root_000997:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Knowledge is rendered as tracking through interfaces, not merely observation of settled objects. Opposed motions form a single continuous field in which crossing a boundary never becomes disappearance.

subchannels.name: Scale-Normalized Inscription
subchannels.scene_or_process: An item is weighed, reduced below ordinary perception, enlarged beyond it, tested for absence, and fixed in a binding record.
subchannels.active_motifs: determinate weight (`quranic:root_000202:B004/m01`), minute particle (`quranic:root_000511:B001/m01`), diminution (`quranic:root_000865:B001/m01`), enlargement (`quranic:root_001281:B001/m01`), escaping or going absent (`quranic:root_001006:B001/m01`), the unseen (`quranic:root_001117:B001/m01`), binding inscription (`quranic:root_001283:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The register normalizes unlike magnitudes: atom, smaller, and greater are equally writable. The latent image of binding inscription makes nonabsence operational rather than merely emphatic.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Passage across boundaries and variation across scales do not produce epistemic loss; movement and measure remain held in one intelligible register.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 34:2 `يَلِجُ`, `يَخْرُجُ`, `يَنزِلُ`, and `يَعْرُجُ`, followed by 34:3 `مِثْقَالُ ذَرَّةٍ`, `أَصْغَرُ`, `أَكْبَرُ`, and `كِتَٰبٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Cosmic direction, subvisible scale, and inscription function as parts of one tracking mechanism rather than as separate proofs of knowledge.

parent_channels.name: P1: Responsive Media Turn Command Into Form

subchannels.name: Return Becomes Resonance
subchannels.scene_or_process: Bestowed excess sets mountains and birds into a shared act of return around David.
subchannels.active_motifs: unowed gift or surplus (`quranic:root_001163:B003/m01`), mountain mass (`quranic:root_000217:B001/m01`), return toward a gathering place (`quranic:root_000065:B001/m01`), flight-bearing birds (`quranic:root_000962:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The imperative to return is distributed across massive and mobile bodies. Praise is thus reframed as resonance: a coordinated reorientation of the surrounding world.

subchannels.name: Protection Articulated by Links
subchannels.scene_or_process: Hard material is softened, expanded into covering, pierced and joined into successive links, and calibrated through intentional work.
subchannels.active_motifs: resistant iron (`quranic:root_000002:B004/m01`), softness against roughness (`quranic:root_001393:B001/m01`), ample covering (`quranic:root_000670:B002/m01`), piercing that links rings (`quranic:root_000695:B002/m01`), bounded calibration (`quranic:root_001205:B001/m01`), purposive work (`quranic:root_001046:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Protection is not a mass of iron but an articulated system whose strength depends on measured openings and joins. Softening and precision cooperate rather than oppose one another.

subchannels.name: Transport Calibrated by Recurrence
subchannels.scene_or_process: Wind-borne movement is divided into morning and return phases, each assigned the same monthly measure.
subchannels.active_motifs: wind as moving medium (`quranic:root_000609:B003/m01`), morning departure (`quranic:root_001076:B001/m01`), evening return (`quranic:root_000609:B005/m01`), calendrical month (`quranic:root_000823:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Extraordinary speed is expressed through recurrence and equal allotment. Movement becomes dependable because departure and return are both measured.

subchannels.name: Molten Source and Licensed Hidden Labor
subchannels.scene_or_process: A metallic source is made to flow while concealed workers operate under permission and remain liable for deviation.
subchannels.active_motifs: released flow (`quranic:root_000770:B001/m01`), flowing source (`quranic:root_001069:B006/m01`), molten copper (`quranic:root_001238:B006/m01`), concealed beings (`quranic:root_000266:B005/m01`), licensed action (`quranic:root_000022:B004/m01`), deviation from course (`quranic:root_000658:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Fluid material and hidden agency are both productive only while routed by authorization. The channel joins metallurgy to governance through the common problem of controlled flow.

subchannels.name: Monumental Receptacles Held in Place
subchannels.scene_or_process: Representational and culinary forms increase in scale until dishes resemble reservoirs and cooking vessels become fixed installations.
subchannels.active_motifs: fashioned representation (`quranic:root_001397:B008/m01`), serving basin (`quranic:root_000250:B002/m01`), collected-water reservoir (`quranic:root_000220:B002/m01`), cooking vessel (`quranic:root_001205:B007/m01`), fixed anchoring (`quranic:root_000564:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Scale changes the status of household objects: dishes become catchments and pots become architecture. The output of hidden labor is materialized as capacity held stable.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Favor and command become visible by making unlike media responsive: bodies return in chorus, metal yields to joining, wind obeys a schedule, molten matter flows, and built vessels hold their assigned form.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 34:10 `أَوِّبِى`, `أَلَنَّا`, and `ٱلْحَدِيدَ`; 34:11 `قَدِّرْ فِى ٱلسَّرْدِ`; 34:12 `ٱلرِّيحَ`, `عَيْنَ ٱلْقِطْرِ`, and `بِإِذْنِ`; 34:13 `تَمَٰثِيلَ`, `جِفَانٍ`, `جَوَابِ`, `قُدُورٍ`, and `رَّاسِيَٰتٍ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Landscape, animal movement, transport, metallurgy, hidden labor, and monumental craft are coordinated as different material responses to directed agency.

parent_channels.name: P1: Rupture Discloses Hidden State

subchannels.name: Enclosure Breached From Below or Above
subchannels.scene_or_process: Stable habitation is pressured by two opposed failures, ground subsidence below and detached canopy fragments falling from above.
subchannels.active_motifs: earth subsidence (`quranic:root_000410:B001/m01`), cutting apart (`quranic:root_001298:B001/m01`), detached fragment (`quranic:root_001298:B004/m01`), downward fall (`quranic:root_000719:B001/m01`), visible sign (`quranic:root_000074:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The earth and sky cease to be passive scenery and become vulnerable boundaries around the observer. Either breach would turn the surrounding structure itself into a sign.

subchannels.name: Eroded Support Exposes Delayed Ignorance
subchannels.scene_or_process: Death has already occurred, but labor continues until a wood-eating process consumes the support, causes collapse, and reveals the workers' ignorance.
subchannels.active_motifs: decisive completion (`quranic:root_001237:B003/m01`), loss of life and power (`quranic:root_001454:B001/m01`), wood-eating termite resonance (`quranic:root_000025:B010/m01`), consumption (`quranic:root_000043:B001/m01`), corrosion or decay (`quranic:root_000043:B006/m01`), staff or goad (`quranic:root_001493:B002/m01`), noisy collapse (`quranic:root_000402:B001/m01`), becoming manifest (`quranic:root_000170:B004/m01`), prolonged remaining (`quranic:root_001339:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Authority appears to persist because its support remains upright after life has gone. Minute consumption eventually makes the hidden temporal gap material, so collapse becomes an epistemic event.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A concealed condition becomes publicly legible when an enclosing surface or load-bearing support fails.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Threatened cosmic fracture and the quiet erosion of a staff share a disclosure logic: structural failure converts what was denied or unknown into visible evidence.

parent_channels.name: P2: Provisioned Habitat Depends on Retained Flow and Response

subchannels.name: Bounded Abundance
subchannels.scene_or_process: A settled place holds paired gardens, edible yield, apportioned provision, and a right-hand resonance of blessing, inviting a visible return of gratitude.
subchannels.active_motifs: bounded town (`quranic:root_000148:B001/m01`), inhabited dwelling (`quranic:root_000726:B002/m01`), tree-covered garden (`quranic:root_000266:B003/m01`), crop and fruit yield (`quranic:root_000043:B002/m01`), apportioned provision (`quranic:root_000560:B001/m01`), recognition of gift (`quranic:root_000810:B001/m01`), wholesome goodness (`quranic:root_000961:B001/m01`), blessing in the right-hand field (`quranic:root_001698:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The gardens are not isolated possessions but components of a bounded provisioning system. The right-side garden also activates a blessing sense, making spatial arrangement carry evaluative force.

subchannels.name: Retention Failure and Ecological Substitution
subchannels.scene_or_process: Released flood crosses a retaining structure, and a productive garden system is exchanged for altered taste, harder growth, and scarcity.
subchannels.active_motifs: releasing or sending (`quranic:root_000563:B001/m01`), torrent flow (`quranic:root_000770:B001/m01`), flood-retaining dam (`quranic:root_001003:B002/m01`), substitution (`quranic:root_000095:B001/m01`), altered or sour taste (`quranic:root_000441:B004/m01`), deep-rooted tamarisk (`quranic:root_000012:B002/m01`), scarcity (`quranic:root_001251:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Punitive change is rendered as system substitution rather than simple removal. Water still moves and vegetation remains, but their former relations to containment, taste, and abundance have been inverted.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Abundance is an engineered relation among bounded settlement, productive landscape, controlled water, and grateful reception; when reception turns, flow and yield are reconfigured.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Gratitude belongs to the habitat's operating structure, while ingratitude appears as a change in hydraulic retention and botanical output.

parent_channels.name: P2: Route Topology Mirrors Moral Connectivity

subchannels.name: Calibrated Corridor
subchannels.scene_or_process: Visible settlements form successive nodes along a measured route traversable by night or day in security.
subchannels.active_motifs: gathered settlement (`quranic:root_001222:B001/m01`), outward visibility (`quranic:root_000970:B001/m01`), bounded calibration (`quranic:root_001205:B001/m01`), movement by travel (`quranic:root_000769:B001/m01`), route or method (`quranic:root_000769:B002/m01`), night (`quranic:root_001392:B001/m01`), day (`quranic:root_001700:B001/m01`), security and trust (`quranic:root_000054:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Safety is produced by legible adjacency, not by the absence of distance. Measurement turns separated settlements into a traversable method.

subchannels.name: Desired Distance Becomes Fragmentation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Travelers request greater separation, wrong themselves, and are transformed from connected subjects into narrated remnants and dispersed pieces.
subchannels.active_motifs: making distance (`quranic:root_000131:B003/m01`), crossing a journey (`quranic:root_000712:B003/m01`), the self as the affected whole (`quranic:root_001533:B012/m01`), transforming into a state (`quranic:root_000248:B002/m01`), stories transmitted after the event (`quranic:root_000299:B004/m01`), tearing into scattered pieces (`quranic:root_001418:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The requested gap migrates from roads into the community itself. Once the corridor is broken, living travelers survive only as separated reports.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A safe corridor exists through measured intervals and visible nodes; the desire to enlarge those intervals converts connectivity into dispersion and story-fragments.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 34:18 `قُرًى ظَٰهِرَةً`, `قَدَّرْنَا فِيهَا ٱلسَّيْرَ`, and `ءَامِنِينَ`; 34:19 `بَٰعِدْ بَيْنَ أَسْفَارِنَا` and `مَزَّقْنَٰهُمْ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Geographic spacing and social coherence obey the same topology: measured separation supports movement, but desired remoteness destroys the network that made movement safe.

parent_channels.name: P2: Unsupported Agency Is Stripped Through Successive Filters

subchannels.name: Followership Without Coercive Force
subchannels.scene_or_process: A conjecture is confirmed by voluntary following, while lack of coercive authority permits belief and doubt to become distinguishable.
subchannels.active_motifs: conjectural assumption (`quranic:root_000969:B003/m01`), fulfillment of expectation (`quranic:root_000852:B004/m01`), following (`quranic:root_000175:B001/m01`), separated group (`quranic:root_001148:B005/m01`), coercive authority (`quranic:root_000732:B001/m01`), assent of belief (`quranic:root_000054:B002/m01`), unresolved doubt (`quranic:root_000812:B001/m01`), guarding oversight (`quranic:root_000342:B001/m01`)

subchannels.name: Proprietary Claim Dismantled by Inventory
subchannels.scene_or_process: Claimed affiliates are audited for the smallest unit of ownership, a shared portion, or a supporting role, and each category remains empty.
subchannels.active_motifs: claiming a right or affiliation (`quranic:root_000478:B002/m01`), ownership and control (`quranic:root_001444:B002/m01`), determinate weight (`quranic:root_000202:B004/m01`), minute particle (`quranic:root_000511:B001/m01`), shared ownership (`quranic:root_000791:B001/m01`), backing support (`quranic:root_000970:B006/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The claim is not met by a generic denial but by a decreasing inventory of possible agency: own, share, or assist. Even atom-scale title is unavailable.

subchannels.name: Mediation Opens Only After Fear Clears
subchannels.scene_or_process: Intercession remains inert until permission is given; fear is then removed from hearts and inquiry resolves into true speech.
subchannels.active_motifs: joining another through intercession (`quranic:root_000802:B002/m01`), authorization (`quranic:root_000022:B004/m01`), removal of fear (`quranic:root_001152:B004/m01`), heart and intellect (`quranic:root_001248:B001/m01`), articulated speech (`quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`), truth matching reality (`quranic:root_000347:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Permission does more than authorize a plea; it changes the hearer's state from alarm to intelligible exchange. Valid mediation is therefore a regulated speech event.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Alleged secondary agency is tested first as influence over followers, then as ownership or partnership, and finally as permission to mediate.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The argument does not deny every relation at once; it distinguishes persuasion from coercion, a claim from possession, shared title from actual support, and speech from licensed mediation.

parent_channels.name: P2: Separated Accounts Converge in Relational Sorting

subchannels.name: Reversible Orientation, Separate Liability
subchannels.scene_or_process: Provision is admitted as a shared question, guidance and clear deviation are placed in reversible positions, and each side's acts remain on its own account.
subchannels.active_motifs: apportioned provision (`quranic:root_000560:B001/m01`), guidance toward a true route (`quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`), deviation from the route (`quranic:root_000913:B001/m01`), culpable offense (`quranic:root_000239:B004/m01`), purposive action (`quranic:root_001046:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The address suspends immediate assignment of guidance and error without merging them. Its balanced form protects a sharper distinction between separate liabilities.

subchannels.name: Assembly Judges and Detaches
subchannels.scene_or_process: Dispersed parties are gathered, judgment opens between them in truth, and alleged partners are exposed as persons wrongly attached to an affiliation.
subchannels.active_motifs: gathering the dispersed (`quranic:root_000259:B001/m01`), judicial opening (`quranic:root_001124:B003/m01`), truth matching reality (`quranic:root_000347:B001/m01`), knowing disclosure (`quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`), wrongful affiliation attachment (`quranic:root_001347:B002/m01`), shared partnership (`quranic:root_000791:B001/m01`), prevailing authority (`quranic:root_001008:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Gathering does not erase difference; it supplies the setting in which relations can be adjudicated. The latent fostered-or-attached sense of `أَلْحَقْتُم` recasts partnership as a manufactured social placement.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Dialogue first keeps opposed positions and liabilities distinct, then gathers the parties so truth can sort valid relations from fabricated attachments.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Rhetorical symmetry is temporary rather than relativizing: separated accounts preserve responsibility until adjudication can expose false affiliation.

parent_channels.name: P3: Dispatch Meets Socially Stratified Reception

subchannels.name: Human-Wide Paired Dispatch
subchannels.scene_or_process: A commissioned sending encompasses the people through paired good-news and warning functions despite widespread nonrecognition.
subchannels.active_motifs: commissioned sending (`quranic:root_000563:B001/m01`), total encompassment (`quranic:root_001308:B006/m01`), human creature (`quranic:root_000120:B002/m01`), glad tidings (`quranic:root_000120:B005/m01`), danger announcement (`quranic:root_001488:B001/m01`), knowing versus ignorance (`quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Universality is not only numerical. The human sense latent in `بَشِيرًا` makes the message's mode answer to the kind of being addressed, while warning and good news preserve its two possible receptions.

subchannels.name: Affluence Filters Settlement Reception
subchannels.scene_or_process: Warning enters a gathered settlement, where those expanded by luxury voice collective refusal.
subchannels.active_motifs: gathered settlement (`quranic:root_001222:B001/m01`), luxury and undisciplined ease (`quranic:root_000179:B001/m01`), danger announcement (`quranic:root_001488:B001/m01`), denial and rejection (`quranic:root_001307:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The settlement receives the message through a socially positioned mouth. Affluence is not incidental description but the condition that converts warning into an assertion of immunity.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A warning mission is broadly dispatched, but reception is filtered by ignorance and by the interests of affluent settlement elites.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The same `ب ش ر` surface that carries glad tidings also activates the human creature, joining universal audience and messenger function within one lexical hinge.

parent_channels.name: P3: Command-Chain Blame Becomes Embodied Restraint

subchannels.name: Detained Dialogue Reconstructs Delegated Agency
subchannels.scene_or_process: Parties are stopped before the Lord and return speech to one another as the weakened accuse the status-bearing arrogant of obstruction.
subchannels.active_motifs: detention at a standing place (`quranic:root_001676:B001/m01`), returned speech (`quranic:root_000544:B005/m01`), imposed weakness (`quranic:root_000909:B001/m01`), elevated social rank (`quranic:root_001281:B005/m01`), arrogance against truth (`quranic:root_001281:B006/m01`), obstruction (`quranic:root_000848:B001/m01`), guidance toward a route (`quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`), culpable offense (`quranic:root_000239:B004/m01`)

subchannels.name: Hidden Scheduling Hardens Into Collars
subchannels.scene_or_process: Night-and-day plotting secretly issues commands to install equals; concealed regret then becomes visible through collars and exact recompense.
subchannels.active_motifs: action conducted by night (`quranic:root_001392:B002/m01`), daytime operation (`quranic:root_001559:B002/m01`), concealed counsel (`quranic:root_000697:B001/m01`), binding command (`quranic:root_000051:B002/m01`), installed equals (`quranic:root_001484:B002/m01`), regret (`quranic:root_001485:B001/m01`), iron restraint (`quranic:root_001102:B006/m01`), the neck as bearing point (`quranic:root_001053:B001/m01`), recompense matching action (`quranic:root_000244:B001/m01`)

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: At the final standing, diffuse influence is reconstructed as a chain of obstruction, scheduled plotting, command, compliance, regret, and recompense, ending in bodily restraint.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 34:31-32 `مَوْقُوفُونَ`, `يَرْجِعُ بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَىٰ بَعْضٍ ٱلْقَوْلَ`, and `صَدَدْنَٰكُمْ`; 34:33 `مَكْرُ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ`, `تَأْمُرُونَنَا`, and `ٱلْأَغْلَٰلَ فِىٓ أَعْنَاقِ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: A social command structure is translated step by step into a restraint structure; what passed down as instruction returns upward as accusation and finally closes around the neck.

parent_channels.name: P3: Quantity and Proximity Run on Different Economies

subchannels.name: Numerical Abundance as False Immunity
subchannels.scene_or_process: Wealth and children are counted as protective superiority, but provision is shown to expand and contract independently of that claim.
subchannels.active_motifs: accumulated wealth (`quranic:root_001457:B001/m01`), offspring (`quranic:root_001683:B001/m01`), rivalry through abundance (`quranic:root_001286:B002/m01`), expansion (`quranic:root_000116:B001/m01`), constriction (`quranic:root_001205:B004/m01`), apportioned provision (`quranic:root_000560:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Quantity is real but not self-interpreting. Because its expansion and restriction belong to another agency, abundance cannot serve as evidence of immunity.

subchannels.name: Nearness Recomputed as Enacted Return
subchannels.scene_or_process: Wealth and offspring fail to move their holders closer, while belief and action are converted into multiplied recompense, elevated chambers, and security.
subchannels.active_motifs: relational nearness (`quranic:root_001212:B001/m01`), assent of belief (`quranic:root_000054:B002/m01`), purposive work (`quranic:root_001046:B001/m01`), multiplication (`quranic:root_000909:B002/m01`), upper chambers (`quranic:root_001079:B002/m01`), security and trust (`quranic:root_000054:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Proximity is not purchased by what one has but generated by what one enacts. The resulting multiplication is qualitative as well as numerical because it terminates in secure placement.

subchannels.name: Expenditure Re-enters Provision
subchannels.scene_or_process: Provision expands or contracts, expenditure moves outward, and what leaves the holder is replaced from the same provisioning system.
subchannels.active_motifs: expansion (`quranic:root_000116:B001/m01`), constriction (`quranic:root_001205:B004/m01`), expenditure that diminishes possession (`quranic:root_001537:B002/m01`), replacement of what is lost (`quranic:root_000433:B001/m01`), apportioned provision (`quranic:root_000560:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Spending is not represented as a terminal leak. It participates in a circulation whose source can replace what exits, pressing the possessive model of wealth used earlier in the pericope.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Material quantity is variably expanded or restricted, while genuine proximity is produced through belief, work, secure recompense, and expenditure that re-enters provision.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 34:35-36 `أَكْثَرُ أَمْوَٰلًا وَأَوْلَٰدًا`, `يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ`, and `يَقْدِرُ`; 34:37 `تُقَرِّبُ`, `جَزَآءُ ٱلضِّعْفِ`, and `ٱلْغُرُفَٰتِ`; 34:39 `أَنفَقْتُم` and `يُخْلِفُهُ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The `ض ع ف` field reverses its role inside P3: socially weakened people in 34:31-33 are followed by doubled recompense in 34:37, unsettling the hierarchy that equates present strength with rank.

parent_channels.name: P4: Authority Is Tested by Capacity, Provenance, and Proportion

subchannels.name: Reciprocal Power Test
subchannels.scene_or_process: Each party is tested for ownership of even partial benefit or harm, and denial culminates in experienced consequence.
subchannels.active_motifs: ownership and control (`quranic:root_001444:B002/m01`), benefit (`quranic:root_001536:B001/m01`), harm and diminishment (`quranic:root_000907:B001/m01`), part set against whole (`quranic:root_000133:B001/m01`), experienced taste (`quranic:root_000526:B002/m01`), punitive pain (`quranic:root_000994:B005/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Claimed relation is reduced to an operational question: can one party alter another's condition? The failure of reciprocal capacity leaves only the consequence of the denied fire as something directly experienced.

subchannels.name: Inherited Practice Confronts Clear Signs
subchannels.scene_or_process: Clarified signs arrive and are treated as an attempt to obstruct inherited worship through separation from ancestral authority.
subchannels.active_motifs: visible sign (`quranic:root_000074:B003/m01`), clarification that reveals meaning (`quranic:root_000170:B005/m01`), obstruction and turning away (`quranic:root_000848:B001/m01`), ancestral fathers (`quranic:root_000007:B001/m01`), worshipful submission (`quranic:root_000973:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The objection identifies truth by its disruptive effect on inherited continuity. Clear exposition is recoded as social obstruction because ancestral practice has been allowed to function as authority.

subchannels.name: Arrival Is Neutralized by Relabeling
subchannels.scene_or_process: Fabrication is attributed to the messenger, while truth at the moment of arrival is relabeled as deceptive magic.
subchannels.active_motifs: fabricated accusation (`quranic:root_001150:B003/m01`), deceptive redirection (`quranic:root_000682:B002/m01`), truth matching reality (`quranic:root_000347:B001/m01`), arrival into the scene (`quranic:root_000281:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Rejection operates by renaming both source and event. The charge of fabrication discredits production, while the magic label converts truth's effective arrival into evidence against it.

subchannels.name: Unsupported Text and Failed Scale Comparison
subchannels.scene_or_process: The rejecters possess no books they have studied and no prior warning mission, yet repeat the denial of predecessors despite having received only a fraction of their material scale.
subchannels.active_motifs: written books (`quranic:root_001283:B002/m01`), sustained study (`quranic:root_000470:B002/m01`), message-bearing envoy (`quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`), warning announcement (`quranic:root_001488:B001/m01`), temporal precedence (`quranic:root_001198:B002/m01`), one-tenth share (`quranic:root_001016:B003/m01`), denial (`quranic:root_001290:B002/m01`), repudiation made manifest (`quranic:root_001550:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The textual claim lacks a studied object, and the historical claim fails proportional comparison. Earlier magnitude did not prevent denial, so reduced present scale cannot explain or excuse the repeated response.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Counterfeit authority fails operational, textual, and historical tests: it cannot act, furnish a valid source, or withstand comparison with earlier recipients.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 34:42 `لَا يَمْلِكُ بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ نَّفْعًا وَلَا ضَرًّا`; 34:43 `ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٍ`, `مُّفْتَرًى`, and `سِحْرٌ`; 34:44-45 `كُتُبٍ يَدْرُسُونَهَا`, `نَّذِيرٍ`, and `مِعْشَارَ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The sequence moves from what an authority can do, to what legitimates its claims, to the scale of evidence already rejected, preventing inherited familiarity from substituting for any of the three.

parent_channels.name: P4: Discernment Is Decompressed From Crowd and Transaction

subchannels.name: Social Decompression Before Thought
subchannels.scene_or_process: Hearers rise with resolve, first in pairs and then singly, and only afterward examine the familiar companion and the charge of madness.
subchannels.active_motifs: bodily standing (`quranic:root_001273:B002/m01`), resolve to undertake (`quranic:root_001273:B003/m01`), pairing (`quranic:root_000208:B001/m01`), solitary separation (`quranic:root_001141:B001/m01`), reflective thought (`quranic:root_001172:B001/m01`), familiar companionship (`quranic:root_000844:B001/m01`), loss-of-reason accusation (`quranic:root_000266:B006/m01`), warning announcement (`quranic:root_001488:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Thought is sequenced after a change in social configuration. The move from crowd to pair to individual allows prior acquaintance with the messenger to be weighed outside collective labeling.

subchannels.name: Nontransactional Witness
subchannels.scene_or_process: Any requested wage is returned to the hearers' own benefit, while compensation is relocated to an all-encompassing witness.
subchannels.active_motifs: asking or requesting (`quranic:root_000661:B001/m01`), wage and recompense (`quranic:root_000015:B001/m01`), witnessing presence (`quranic:root_000822:B001/m01`), decisive testimony (`quranic:root_000822:B002/m01`), the unrestricted object of knowledge (`quranic:root_000831:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Payment cannot explain the warning because the benefit is assigned back to its recipients. Witness replaces transaction as the relation that guarantees the messenger's account.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Reflection is cleared of collective pressure and economic suspicion by reducing the audience to pairs or individuals and removing payment from the message relation.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 34:46 `تَقُومُوا لِلَّهِ مَثْنَىٰ وَفُرَٰدَىٰ ثُمَّ تَتَفَكَّرُوا`; 34:47 `سَأَلْتُكُم مِّنْ أَجْرٍ` and `عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Pairing and solitude form an epistemic protocol, while the rejection of payment removes a second pressure that could distort evaluation.

parent_channels.name: P4: Truth Behaves as Effective One-Way Transmission

subchannels.name: Projected Truth, Sterile Falsehood
subchannels.scene_or_process: Truth is hurled and arrives with establishing force, while falsehood can neither initiate an effect nor produce a return.
subchannels.active_motifs: projectile casting (`quranic:root_001209:B001/m01`), truth matching reality (`quranic:root_000347:B001/m01`), making truth prevail (`quranic:root_000347:B005/m01`), arrival (`quranic:root_000281:B001/m01`), unstable falsehood (`quranic:root_000127:B001/m01`), initiating production (`quranic:root_000090:B001/m01`), recurrence or return (`quranic:root_001058:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Truth is not static content but an effective arrival from a knowing source. Falsehood's failure is described as process failure: it cannot originate a durable act or send one back.

subchannels.name: Guidance Received From Near
subchannels.scene_or_process: Error falls back upon the self, while guidance arrives through concealed divine communication whose source hears at close range.
subchannels.active_motifs: departure from guidance (`quranic:root_000913:B001/m01`), the self as bearer of consequence (`quranic:root_001533:B012/m01`), guidance toward the route (`quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`), divine hidden communication (`quranic:root_001633:B004/m01`), hearing (`quranic:root_000741:B001/m01`), relational nearness (`quranic:root_001212:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The verse separates ownership of error from receipt of guidance. Revelation traverses hidden distance without becoming remote because hearing and nearness characterize its source.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Truth originates beyond the speaker, is projected effectively into the scene, and can be received as near guidance; falsehood lacks both generative beginning and productive return.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 34:48-49 `يَقْذِفُ بِٱلْحَقِّ`, `جَآءَ ٱلْحَقُّ`, and `مَا يُبْدِئُ ٱلْبَٰطِلُ وَمَا يُعِيدُ`; 34:50 `يُوحِىٓ إِلَىَّ` and `سَمِيعٌ قَرِيبٌ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Projectile force, recurrence, revelation, hearing, and nearness form a transmission model in which efficacy depends on valid origin rather than rhetorical possession.

parent_channels.name: P4: Deferred Belief Becomes a Geometry of Capture

subchannels.name: Near Seizure Eliminates Escape
subchannels.scene_or_process: Panic erupts, escape becomes impossible, and capture occurs from a position already close at hand.
subchannels.active_motifs: panic (`quranic:root_001152:B001/m01`), failure to elude (`quranic:root_001183:B001/m01`), taking captive (`quranic:root_000018:B003/m01`), spatial proximity (`quranic:root_001212:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The scene collapses the imagined interval required for escape. Capture is near not only geographically but temporally: no further postponement remains available.

subchannels.name: Belated Reach and Distant Projection
subchannels.scene_or_process: Belief is asserted after the decisive moment, but grasping from afar fails while unsupported speech is thrown toward what remains unseen.
subchannels.active_motifs: reaching or taking hold (`quranic:root_001565:B001/m01`), remoteness (`quranic:root_000131:B001/m01`), assent of belief (`quranic:root_000054:B002/m01`), verbal accusation or casting (`quranic:root_001209:B002/m01`), distance extended like travel (`quranic:root_001209:B003/m01`), the unseen (`quranic:root_001117:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The problem is no longer lack of verbal assent but loss of reach. Earlier conjectural projection toward the unseen has produced the very remoteness from which valid belief cannot now be grasped.

subchannels.name: Barrier Seals the Desired Object
subchannels.scene_or_process: A barrier is placed between subjects and what they desire, repeating the condition of comparable groups already settled into destabilizing doubt.
subchannels.active_motifs: separating barrier (`quranic:root_000373:B005/m01`), desire (`quranic:root_000825:B001/m01`), comparable peers (`quranic:root_000836:B007/m01`), unresolved doubt (`quranic:root_000812:B001/m01`), disquieting suspicion (`quranic:root_000616:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Desire remains present, but access becomes structurally impossible. The closing barrier gives final spatial form to a doubt that had long kept truth at an artificial distance.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Once panic arrives, the former freedom to defer is translated into spatial relations: seizure is near, belief is sought from far away, speculative speech is projected toward the unseen, and a barrier closes access to desire.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 34:51 `لَا فَوْتَ وَأُخِذُوا مِن مَّكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ`; 34:52-53 `أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلتَّنَاوُشُ مِن مَّكَانٍ بَعِيدٍ` and `يَقْذِفُونَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ`; 34:54 `حِيلَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ مَا يَشْتَهُونَ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The `ق ذ ف` field reverses the effective projection of truth in 34:48 into distant verbal throwing at the unseen in 34:53, making distance a difference in epistemic warrant.

parent_channels.name: S1. P1: Cutting Becomes the Condition of Novelty
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Complete dismemberment is cited against renewed creation, yet the lexical field of novelty itself retains cutting and fresh formation.
parent_channels.active_motifs: tearing into pieces (`quranic:root_001418:B001/m01`), cutting or severing (`quranic:root_000227:B003/m01`), newness after a cut (`quranic:root_000227:B004/m01`), creating a formed thing (`quranic:root_000434:B002/m01`), report that announces (`quranic:root_001464:B002/m01`), fabricated lie (`quranic:root_001150:B003/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The objection treats fragmentation as the end of form, but the alternate `ج د د` senses make severing and newness adjacent operations. The language used to deny recreation therefore retains a material analogy for it.

parent_channels.name: S2. P3: Appointment Cannot Be Shifted
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A demanded promise is specified as an appointed day whose position cannot move backward or forward even by an hour.
parent_channels.active_motifs: fixed appointment (`quranic:root_001662:B003/m01`), calendrical day (`quranic:root_001700:B001/m01`), postponement (`quranic:root_000019:B002/m01`), forward movement (`quranic:root_001207:B004/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The answer converts a challenge for prediction into a positional invariant. Human demand can name the appointment, but cannot translate it along the temporal axis.

parent_channels.name: S3. P3: Gathered Patrons Reverse Their Assigned Ownership
parent_channels.scene_or_process: All are assembled, angelic patrons are questioned about worship, and they return ownership and protection to God while relocating the worshippers' allegiance toward concealed beings.
parent_channels.active_motifs: total gathering (`quranic:root_000259:B001/m01`), ownership latent in the angelic root (`quranic:root_001444:B002/m01`), worshipful submission (`quranic:root_000973:B003/m01`), disavowing glorification (`quranic:root_000666:B002/m01`), protective patronage (`quranic:root_001684:B004/m01`), concealed beings (`quranic:root_000266:B005/m01`), assent of belief (`quranic:root_000054:B002/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The queried patrons refuse the ownership relation projected onto them. The latent ownership field under `ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ` sharpens the reversal: those treated as possessors identify themselves as protected dependents and redirect the alleged allegiance.

parent_channels.name: S4. Dairying Yield as Grateful Return
parent_channels.scene_or_process: After grazing fills the udder, a kneeling she-camel is milked in the morning, a small remainder is left to draw further milk, and the yield continues in successive flow.
parent_channels.active_motifs: morning milk from a kneeling she-camel (`quranic:root_000109:B007/m01`), retained milk that calls further yield (`quranic:root_000478:B003/m01`), successive milk flow (`quranic:root_000563:B006/m01`), udder fullness after pasture (`quranic:root_000810:B003/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: These senses turn blessing, sending, calling, and gratitude into one husbandry cycle. The scene materializes `ش ك ر` as replenished yield after grazing; by contrast, the sent flood of 34:16 is a destructive counter-flow, and the call to claimed powers in 34:22 produces no return. It supports the primary contrast between responsive provision and sterile affiliation.

parent_channels.name: S5. Provision Is Not a Cast Lot
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Gaming arrows are kept together in a holder, a specifically ranked maysir arrow participates in the draw, and the result is read as fortune or an allotted share.
parent_channels.active_motifs: holder for maysir arrows (`quranic:root_000532:B010/m01`), the fifth maysir arrow (`quranic:root_001533:B016/m01`), fortune and acquired wealth (`quranic:root_000227:B002/m01`), luck construed as provision (`quranic:root_000560:B006/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The apparatus supplies a concrete rival model of allotment: place marked arrows in a holder and let the draw assign fortune. Its activation under `رَبِّى` and `ٱلرِّزْقَ` pressures the affluent inference of 34:35-39 by separating divine provision from lucky outcome, while the specific gaming arrow latent under `نَفْسِى` reinforces that error belongs to an accountable self rather than to an impersonal lot.

parent_channels.name: S6. Nearness Materialized as an Offered Sacrifice
parent_channels.scene_or_process: An offering is directed toward the sanctuary, slaughtered with the knife that stills the animal, and presented as a concrete act of seeking nearness.
parent_channels.active_motifs: sanctuary-bound offering (`quranic:root_001583:B005/m01`), sacrificial offering that seeks nearness (`quranic:root_001212:B005/m01`), slaughter knife that stills the animal (`quranic:root_000726:B007/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The rite materializes nearness as directed surrender rather than retained possession. This usefully pressures 34:37, where wealth and children do not bring their holders near: the latent sacrificial scene makes approach depend on what is handed over and enacted, while the `ه د ي` offering sense reframes guidance as movement deliberately directed toward God.

parent_channels.name: S7. Steering and Mooring Produce Stability
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A vessel is kept from oscillation by its stern or rudder and then held from further travel by its anchor.
parent_channels.active_motifs: ship at anchor or mooring (`quranic:root_000564:B002/m01`), stern or rudder that steadies a ship (`quranic:root_000726:B008/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Placed after the explicit wind of 34:12, the hidden rudder and anchor form a compact navigation sequence of propulsion, steering, and stopping. The scene reframes stability in `ر س و` and `س ك ن` as achieved control over motion rather than invulnerability, sharpening the contrast between Solomon's responsive mobility and Sheba's confidence in settled habitat.

parent_channels.name: S8. Allotment Enters the Body
parent_channels.scene_or_process: An edible share is placed in an eating vessel, tasted by the mouth, and taken into the body as sustaining food.
parent_channels.active_motifs: edible ration or allotted share (`quranic:root_000043:B003/m01`), eating vessel and meal place (`quranic:root_000043:B013/m01`), food that reaches the belly (`quranic:root_000560:B002/m01`), tasting food by mouth (`quranic:root_000526:B001/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The scene joins the offered meal of 34:15 to the commanded taste of 34:42. It materializes moral response as ingestion: accepted provision enters and sustains, while denied truth returns as fire to be tasted. This pressures the surah's rejected wealth-as-possession model by making allotment complete only in embodied reception and consequence.

parent_channels.name: S9. Sent Voice, Returned Refrain, Near Hearing
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A performer works with a singing companion, the voice returns in a repeated refrain, and attentive hearing receives the performance.
parent_channels.active_motifs: melodic return in recitation, song, or call (`quranic:root_000544:B007/m01`), paired accompaniment in singing or work (`quranic:root_000563:B008/m01`), pleasurable song and listening (`quranic:root_000741:B007/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The performance scene extends the responsive chorus of 34:10 across the surah. It reframes the returned speech of 34:31 as a fractured counter-performance in which accusation replaces harmony, while the near hearing of 34:50 supplies the final listener. Repetition thus registers the quality of relation, not mere recurrence.

parent_channels.name: S10. P1-P2-P3-P4, Causal Bridge: Fulfillment Adjudicates Speech
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Renewed creation is branded a lie, an expectation is confirmed through its followers' conduct, an appointed promise is challenged as a test of truthful speech, and the denied consequence finally becomes present.
parent_channels.active_motifs: lie opposed to truth (`quranic:root_001290:B001/m01`), truthful speech matching its referent (`quranic:root_000852:B001/m01`), promise as a verbal commitment fulfilled or broken (`quranic:root_001662:B001/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The causal bridge is fulfillment as the adjudicator of competing speech labels. P1 supplies the accusation of lying, P2 shows an expectation acquiring truth through enacted response, P3 ties truthfulness to a promised appointment, and P4 turns what was denied into experienced consequence. The progression supports the surah's primary claim that an audience cannot determine truth by naming it false: conduct and event make speech answer to its referent.

parent_channels.name: S11. P1-P2 to P4, Contrast Bridge: Covered Liability or Accountable Seizure
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Liability is first presented as coverable so that its bearer is protected from its effect; at the final panic, taking hold carries the alternate sense of holding a person to account for what issued from them.
parent_channels.active_motifs: forgiveness as covering sin and protecting its bearer from consequence (`quranic:root_001096:B002/m01`), taking a person to account for sin (`quranic:root_000018:B002/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The contrast bridge is the alternate handling of one liability: it is either covered with its bearer shielded from the result, or it terminates in the bearer's seizure for account. The forgiving descriptions in P1 and P2 therefore pressure the near capture of P4 with a juridical sense. Mercy is protection from an effect that remains real, while deferred seizure is not acquittal.

parent_channels.name: S12. P1-P4, Causal Bridge: False Attribution Becomes Circulating Rumor
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A false statement is laid against another person, a tale-bearer carries it between people, relations are corrupted, and the saying becomes common social currency.
parent_channels.active_motifs: false speech said against another (`quranic:root_000186:B009/m01`), interpersonal corruption by tale-bearing (`quranic:root_000043:B009/m01`), tale-bearer creeping between people (`quranic:root_000457:B004/m01`), speech circulating widely among people (`quranic:root_001272:B007/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The causal bridge runs from covert carrying to public repetition. P1 supplies the creeping and corrosive motions under the creature-and-eating scene, while P4 places false attribution and repeated communal speech directly beside recited signs. The rumor process usefully pressures the apparent unanimity of rejection in 34:43: a repeated accusation can be socially propagated without becoming evidentially independent.

parent_channels.name: S13. P1-P3, Process Bridge: Hidden Gestation Ends in Birth
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A womb serves as a growth-vessel, gathers and carries a fetus hidden from view, bears increasing weight, and releases the formed child at birth.
parent_channels.active_motifs: womb as the vessel where offspring grows (`quranic:root_000552:B003/m01`), womb gathering and carrying a fetus (`quranic:root_001211:B003/m01`), fetus concealed in the belly (`quranic:root_000266:B007/m01`), pregnancy becoming a bodily load (`quranic:root_000202:B007/m01`), occurrence of childbirth (`quranic:root_001683:B003/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The process bridge is the passage from protected invisibility to embodied emergence. The womb sense beneath the merciful description materializes concealment as formative care, while increasing weight makes hidden growth physically consequential before it can be seen. This reframes P1's denied renewed creation through an ordinary formation sequence: invisibility is not nonbeing, and a completed body can emerge from concealed assembly.

parent_channels.name: S14. P2-P3, Causal Bridge: Regrowth Materializes Replacement
parent_channels.scene_or_process: After an earlier growth has dried or passed away, tender shoots emerge and a subsequent crop or fruit follows the first.
parent_channels.active_motifs: plant or fruit returning after prior loss (`quranic:root_000433:B010/m01`), emergence of tender shoots (`quranic:root_000810:B004/m01`), later growth or fruit following the first (`quranic:root_001347:B003/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The causal bridge is botanical succession between P2's vulnerable garden economy and P3's promise of replacement. Gratitude carries the emergence of fresh shoots, and replacement becomes the return of growth followed by later yield. The scene supports 34:39 by making replenishment regenerative rather than merely financial: what leaves the holder can be succeeded by new production from the provisioning source.

parent_channels.name: S15. P1-P4, Causal Bridge: Collective Kindling Becomes Experienced Fire
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Firewood strengthens a flame, ignition produces a sustained blaze, sparks fall away from it, and the active fire can mark what it reaches.
parent_channels.active_motifs: kindling and strengthening fire with wood (`quranic:root_000836:B005/m01`), ignition and blazing heat (`quranic:root_000708:B001/m01`), falling sparks or embers (`quranic:root_000719:B005/m01`), blazing or branding fire (`quranic:root_001564:B002/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The causal bridge is a combustion sequence joining P1's blaze to P4's commanded experience of fire. The kindling sense under the final mention of comparable peers makes collective continuity intensify rather than avert the outcome: a group can function as reinforcing fuel. The scene materializes punishment as an operating process of feeding, ignition, spread, and contact rather than as a decorative threat.

parent_channels.name: S16. P1-P2-P4, Material Bridge: Excavation Opens a Hidden Provision Source
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Workers establish a new well, dig until hard substrate may stop them, leave an excavation ring around the opening, and enter the uncased well without being lowered by a rope.
parent_channels.active_motifs: newly excavated well (`quranic:root_000090:B008/m01`), establishing a well by digging (`quranic:root_000012:B006/m01`), hard ground halting excavation (`quranic:root_000217:B005/m01`), spoil or hollow around a well (`quranic:root_000220:B003/m01`), uncased well (`quranic:root_001248:B007/m01`), descent into a well without being lowered (`quranic:root_000546:B013/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The material bridge is productive beginning through excavation. P2's provisioned settlement is pressured by a scene in which water access depends on labor, penetrable ground, a maintained opening, and risky bodily entry; abundance is infrastructure rather than autonomous possession. The new-well sense beneath P4's `يُبْدِئُ` also sharpens the contrast with sterile falsehood: genuine initiation opens access to a sustaining source.

parent_channels.name: S17. P2-P3-P4, Contrast Bridge: Household Treasure Is Also a Load
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Wealth and young dependents are gathered into a household, valued as precious objects of competition, yet the same dependents are carried as an encumbering weight.
parent_channels.active_motifs: gathered wealth and dependents (`quranic:root_001222:B011/m01`), young child or dependent (`quranic:root_001683:B004/m01`), dependents as burden (`quranic:root_001315:B002/m01`), precious weight (`quranic:root_000202:B005/m01`), coveted valuable (`quranic:root_001533:B010/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The contrast bridge is the double status of household inventory as treasure and obligation. P3's affluent boast counts wealth and children only as accumulated advantage, but the latent household scene restores the dependence and weight that possession creates. It usefully pressures the claim of immunity in 34:35: what raises social valuation can simultaneously increase the load for which the holder answers.

parent_channels.name: S18. P1-P4, Reversal Bridge: Burial Conceals but Does Not Cancel Return
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Death stills the body, the corpse is covered and placed out of sight in a grave, yet return remains its eventual destination.
parent_channels.active_motifs: death as stillness or decay (`quranic:root_001454:B012/m01`), covering and burying a corpse (`quranic:root_000266:B009/m01`), hiding the dead in a grave (`quranic:root_001117:B009/m01`), return as destination or resurrection (`quranic:root_001058:B002/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The reversal bridge turns burial's concealment into a temporary human condition rather than ontological loss. P1's death-and-unseen scene activates the physical hiding of a body, while P4 retains return as a destination precisely where falsehood is denied any power to return. The sequence supports renewed creation by distinguishing disappearance from annihilation: a body can pass out of human sight without passing out of divine reach.
